capabilities: : Search movies and TV shows via TMDB API
: Generate Markdown records from API data
: Track TV show progress by season and episode
: Display viewing records in a visual card grid
: Input personal viewing data and ratings
problem: Manually gathering and documenting movie and TV show information and tracking viewing progress is time-consuming.

relations.evidence: Highly recommended to be used alongside the Obsidian-projects plugin.

summary: A plugin that searches for movies and TV shows using the TMDB API and automatically generates Markdown notes with metadata and tracking capabilities.
